scope: CPU transcript search using authoritative JSONL and a derived contentless FTS5 index

requirements.contract: No duplicated message bodies; full word positions and document lengths; private derived storage
Append/rewrite/delete/partial-record refresh; authenticate hydrated text; reject unsafe paths and stale records
Ranked words/phrases, exact literal matching, selected branch ancestry and bounded source expansion
UI-independent work, explicit project scope, cancellation, deadline and worker recovery
Real Pi tool/context wiring, recover original pre-compaction messages and preserve existing active tools
Host and VM launchers package entrypoint, worker and index; installed offline execution requires no inference
